title: MILO Marathon 2026 Tagbilaran Leg Review: An Evening Race in Bohol's Capital
seo_title: MILO Marathon Tagbilaran Leg 2026 Review | Bohol
meta_description: MILO Marathon 2026 Tagbilaran Leg review: September 13, an unusual 6:05pm start, part of the 50th-anniversary Golden Run series in Bohol's capital city.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 with an unusual 6:05pm timeslot, this Tagbilaran leg is one of 15 stops on the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary Golden Run series, held in Bohol's small, walkable provincial capital.
verdict: The Tagbilaran leg stands out within the MILO Marathon's 2026 Golden Run series for one specific reason: it's listed with a 6:05pm timeslot, unusual for a series that typically runs early-morning legs to beat the heat. Four distances (3K/5K/10K/21K) keep it accessible, and past editions have offered a full entitlement structure -- singlets and bibs for all, finisher shirts and medals for 10K/21K/42K finishers. Tagbilaran itself is Bohol's compact, walkable provincial capital, small enough (just 36.5 sq km, roughly 105,000 people) that logistics are simple compared to sprawling Metro Manila legs.

sections.heading: An Unusual Evening Timeslot
paragraphs: The 2026 Tagbilaran Leg offers 3K, 5K, 10K, and 21K distances, with the event listed for a 6:05pm timeslot on 13 September 2026. [1] That's a genuine departure from the pre-dawn starts typical of most MILO Marathon legs and most Philippine road races generally -- worth double-checking with organisers, since an evening start changes heat exposure, lighting needs, and post-race logistics considerably.

sections.heading: One of 15 Legs in the Golden Run
paragraphs: This leg is one of 15 regional races in the 2026 MILO Marathon series, which marks the 50th anniversary of the country's longest-running grassroots race, with the National Finals held 8 December in Clark City, Pampanga. [1] That anniversary framing gives every 2026 leg, including Tagbilaran's, a bit more institutional weight than an ordinary annual stop.

sections.heading: Entitlements: What Past Editions Offered
paragraphs: Past Tagbilaran editions (2024) offered a singlet and race bib for all entrants, with finisher shirts and lootbags reserved for 21K/42K finishers and finisher medals for 10K/21K/42K finishers. [1] Registration and event logistics are handled online via Race Roster, with RUNRIO Inc. as the event organizer of record.

sections.heading: Tagbilaran: A Compact Provincial Capital
paragraphs: Tagbilaran is the capital of Bohol province, a compact city of just 36.5 square kilometres with a 2020 census population of roughly 105,000, nicknamed the 'City of Peace and Friendship.' [2] That small footprint makes a race in Tagbilaran genuinely walkable compared to sprawling Metro Manila legs -- kit collection, hotel, and start line are all likely to be within easy reach of each other.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a MILO Marathon leg in a small, easy-to-navigate provincial capital appeals, and the unusual evening start time doesn't put you off, the Tagbilaran leg on 13 September 2026 is a reasonable choice within the 50th-anniversary Golden Run series. Confirm the 6:05pm timeslot and lighting/safety arrangements directly with organisers before committing, since it's an atypical format for this series.
